_about: What every rule group on the settings page means. One entry per `group:` in rules.yaml, so a page of 30 switches reads as a few decisions. `category` names the section it sits under; `sample` is a spec the drawing core renders into the little preview beside the toggle (omit it where the kind is drawn by Mermaid, not by the core). dashboard/selfcheck.py fails if a group in rules.yaml has no entry here.

categories.title: Structuring the answer
categories.blurb: What the plugin adds on top of the model's own words — a heading where the answer already behaves like one.

categories.title: Numeric charts
categories.blurb: Numbers the answer already states, drawn as bars, KPIs, spans and flows.

categories.title: Cards
categories.blurb: Answer-shaped widgets: lists, tables and grids the answer already contains, laid out as a card.

categories.title: Diagrams
categories.blurb: Shapes that genuinely want a diagram, handed to Mermaid to draw.

structure.title: Section headings
structure.blurb: Promotes a heading the answer already carries — an all-bold line, or a short line above a list — to `##`, and a division inside one to `###`.

numbers.title: Number runs
numbers.blurb: A run of `Label: 12` lines becomes a bar chart — or a KPI pair when the run is exactly two rows.

tables.title: Numeric tables
tables.blurb: A markdown table whose body is mostly numbers becomes a bar chart of its first numeric column.

metrics.title: Metrics with deltas
metrics.blurb: `Label: value (delta)` rows become a metric grid, each tile naming the value and its change.

ranges.title: Ranges
ranges.blurb: `Label: lo..hi` rows become span bars on one shared scale, so overlaps between them are visible.

heatmap.title: Heatmaps
heatmap.blurb: A long numeric run (six rows or more) becomes a grid of cells on a 0…max colour ramp.

funnel.title: Funnels
funnel.blurb: A strictly decreasing run whose labels name stages becomes a funnel, naming the size of each drop.

scatter.title: Scatter plots
scatter.blurb: `x=y` rows — a number on both sides of the `=` — become points on two axes.

waterfall.title: Waterfalls
waterfall.blurb: A run stepping both `+n` and `-n` becomes a waterfall, each bar carried from the running total.

checklist.title: Checklists
checklist.blurb: A task run (`- [x] done`, `- [ ] todo`) becomes rows with a state glyph; done items are struck through.

changes.title: Diff summaries (off by default)
changes.blurb: A `path +12 -3` run drawn as a changed-files card. The app draws that list itself, so this is the copy to leave alone.

outline.title: Outlines
outline.blurb: A dotted-number run (`1. Title`, `1.1 Sub`) becomes a contents list, indented by its depth.

steps.title: Step lists
steps.blurb: An ordered list of short items becomes a numbered runbook.

sample.d: Read the archive;Patch the entry;Flash the board

facts.title: Fact cards
facts.blurb: A `Label: value` run of text values becomes a definition card — a muted label above a strong value.

files.title: File lists
files.blurb: A `path: meta` run becomes a file listing with a kind glyph and a muted meta column.

parts.title: Bills of materials
parts.blurb: A table of parts and quantities becomes a BOM, with quantities right-aligned.

settings.title: On/off settings
settings.blurb: A `Label: on|off` run becomes toggle rows, each state shown as a pill.

timeline.title: Timelines
timeline.blurb: A `when — label — detail` run becomes a vertical timeline on a rail.

array.title: Inline matrices
array.blurb: A run of `a | b | c` rows becomes a bordered matrix — a grid of cells, not a table.

wireframe.title: Wireframes
wireframe.blurb: `Label: block:count` rows become a UI mock of proportional labelled blocks — never real pixels.

candlestick.title: Candlesticks
candlestick.blurb: `when: open:high:low:close` rows become OHLC candles on one shared scale.

bracket.title: Brackets
bracket.blurb: Rounds of `winner>loser` pairings become a knockout bracket.

gloss.title: Glosses
gloss.blurb: A `source=gloss=note` line becomes a word-aligned interlinear gloss.

forms.title: Paradigm grids
forms.blurb: A table whose header is grammatical categories becomes a labelled forms grid.

flow.title: Flowcharts
flow.blurb: An `A -> B -> C` arrow chain becomes a Mermaid flowchart.

mermaid.title: Other diagrams
mermaid.blurb: Named states, an exchange of messages, a schedule, shares of one whole and dated events become Mermaid diagrams.

records.title: Value rows
records.blurb: Any run of label=value rows, drawn as a labelled value list — the fallback shape, so unfamiliar data still reads.

sample.d: Pallet=12 crates of tile;Container=40 ft high cube;Customs=cleared for release

grid.title: Cell grids
grid.blurb: A table with a header row and equal-width rows, drawn as a matrix rather than a chart. A ragged table is not a grid.

events.title: Time events
events.blurb: A time or date with a label, drawn on a rail. Rows carrying an `=` are a record shape, never an event.

groups.title: Repeated labels
groups.blurb: Rows whose first cell repeats, drawn as grouped rows under a sub-heading.
